value.rationale: The exact class equation and commuting probability are natural complete invariants of a standard finite-dimensional nilpotent unit group. Five generators mark the first nontrivial split of nonzero cubic odd elements into decomposable and nondecomposable five-dimensional trivectors, producing two genuine intermediate centralizer strata for every odd finite field.
